name: Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler
summary: At Dreadmist Peak, druids seek tainted water in an empty Cenarion vessel. The sample may help diagnose and cure the blight spreading among wildlife in the northern Barrens.

sections.title: Tracing the Blight
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze suspects the pools atop Dreadmist Peak are at the heart of a sickness afflicting gazelles and unsettling the northern Barrens. The pools influence the weather, and the druid fears they are tied to the spreading blight. He sends druid initiates with empty samplers to brave the mountain heights and draw water from the peak. The Burning Blade, a demon-worshipping cult, now infests the mountain.

sections.title: A Crucial Specimen
sections.body: Druids carry the empty sampler up Dreadmist Peak to collect water from its pool. They take the sample to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, where it can help him devise a cure and protect the native wildlife.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler?
aliases: why do i have this sampler
faq.answer: The Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler is an empty container, a specialized Cenarion vessel druids use to draw water from the tainted pool atop Dreadmist Peak. They bring the sample to Tonga Runetotem to help devise a cure for sickened wildlife.

faq.q: Where does this sampler need to be taken?
aliases: where do i fill the sampler
how to fill empty dreadmist peak sampler
faq.answer: Carry the sampler to the high pool atop Dreadmist Peak, northwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens, and draw a water sample.
Dendrite Starblaze provides the sampler on behalf of the Cenarion Circle, then sends the druid to coordinate with Tonga Runetotem.

faq.q: Why is the water on Dreadmist Peak so important to sample?
faq.answer: The pools atop Dreadmist Peak influence regional weather and mist. The Burning Blade cult has corrupted the summit, and tainted runoff spreads across the plains and poisons local creatures.

angles.text: As a druid, collecting a sample with this vessel is part of learning to cure poisons and to diagnose and ease suffering in the wild.
As a member of the Horde, you carry this sampler to aid Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads as he works to stop ecological decay across the Barrens' northern plains.
